purpose: Separate present capability, integration targets, and speculative future design while preserving human authority.

use_cases.title: Artifact sealing and verification
use_cases.summary: Generate explicit-coverage SHA-256 receipts and verify later byte identity, with C2PA-facing interoperability available as a tested bridge.

use_cases.title: Privacy-first declared educational context
use_cases.summary: Represent temporary human-declared context with machine_inferred=false and deny-by-default profiling, training, secondary-use, and psychological-inference permissions.

use_cases.title: Agent discovery and bounded interpretation
use_cases.summary: Expose deterministic recommendation, citation, summaries, knowledge graphs, origin metadata, machine targets, and distribution boundaries.

use_cases.title: Human authorization gateway for autonomous agents
use_cases.summary: Use SEP-1 as the policy state machine inside a real deployment that supplies an external human-authentication trust root before sensitive tool execution.

use_cases.title: Cross-format semantic verifier
use_cases.summary: Verify that all generated machine formats preserve one canonical semantic core rather than assuming equivalent exports are equivalent meanings.

use_cases.title: Planetary infrastructure with delegated human authority
use_cases.summary: Use signed human-defined mission envelopes to allow reversible autonomous operation while escalating unknown or irreversible decisions.

use_cases.title: Predictive civil-rights safeguard
use_cases.summary: Treat predictive models as evidence inputs rather than legal identity, destiny, or automatic sentence.

use_cases.title: Deep-space anomaly processing
use_cases.summary: Preserve raw evidence, continue only reversible observation, and halt irreversible intervention when an unknown falls outside the mission ontology.
